# Xgenious — Custom Software Development Company

> Xgenious builds custom SaaS, web apps, mobile apps, and AI agents for mid-market teams. Fixed-price contracts. UK · US · UAE · BD.

## Services

- [Custom SaaS Development](https://xgenious.com/custom-saas-development-company): End-to-end SaaS products from MVP to scale
- [Web App Development](https://xgenious.com/web-app-development-company): B2B portals, dashboards, enterprise platforms
- [Mobile App Development](https://xgenious.com/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android, cross-platform
- [AI Agent Development](https://xgenious.com/ai-agent-development-services): Custom AI agents and workflow automation
- [MVP Development](https://xgenious.com/saas-mvp-development): Working product in 6–8 weeks

## Free Open Source Software

Xgenious publishes free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted software anyone can download, fork, and deploy.

### Genius School Management
Free school ERP system. Laravel 11 + React 18. 19 modules: student admissions, attendance, fees, exams, payroll, library, transport, hostel, inventory. Multi-school support. MIT licensed.
- [Genius School Management landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-school-management)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 11, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL/PostgreSQL
- Target users: Schools, colleges, NGOs, software agencies

### Genius CRM
Free self-hosted CRM. Laravel 12 + React 19. 12 modules: contacts, leads, deal pipeline (Kanban), tasks, company profiles, RBAC, REST API, 2FA, Docker.
- [Genius CRM landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-crm)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js, MySQL
- Target users: Solo founders, small sales teams, developers, agencies

### Genius HRM
Free open-source HR management system. Laravel 13 + React 18. 13 modules: employees, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment (ATS), performance management. 6 roles, 55 permissions.
- [Genius HRM landing page](https://xgenious.com/free-software/genius-hrm)
- License: MIT
- Stack: Laravel 13, React 18, Inertia.js, MySQL, shadcn/ui
- Target users: SMEs, HR teams, developers, agencies

### Botmerze — AI Chatbot SaaS Script for WooCommerce & Shopify
RAG-powered AI chatbot SaaS script. Trains on your store's knowledge base (PDFs, URLs, WooCommerce/Shopify live sync, YouTube transcripts, images via OCR). Answers product questions, order status, returns; captures leads 24/7. Self-hosted, one-time purchase, use your own OpenAI API key.
- [Botmerze product page](https://xgenious.com/products/botmerze-ai-chatbot-saas-ecommerce)
- [Live demo](https://botmerze.bytesed.com)
- [Purchase on CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/item/botmerze-ai-chatbot-saas-for-ecommerce-with-woocommerce-shopify-api-integration/63267734)
- Stack: Laravel 12, PHP 8.3+, PostgreSQL 16+ + pgvector (RAG), OpenAI GPT (your API key), Redis, Tesseract OCR
- Pricing: Regular $49 (one-time) / Everything Bundle $69 (one-time, SaaS rights) / Exclusive $199 (one-time, white-label + source code) — no monthly fees
- Key features: RAG with pgvector embeddings, WooCommerce & Shopify real-time sync, multi-client SaaS management, drag-and-drop widget builder, lead capture, 18+ payment gateways for SaaS billing, built-in support ticket system with human handoff, product recommendations & cross-sell, OCR image training, YouTube transcript ingestion
- Comparison: vs Tidio ($29–$499/mo), vs Intercom ($74+/mo), vs Gorgias ($50+/mo) — Botmerze is one-time, self-hosted, no per-seat pricing
- Keywords: AI chatbot SaaS, WooCommerce chatbot, Shopify chatbot, self-hosted chatbot script, RAG chatbot, Laravel chatbot, ecommerce AI chatbot, chatbot SaaS script

### Grenmart — Organic & Grocery Laravel eCommerce Script
Organic grocery and multipurpose eCommerce platform built on Laravel. No-code drag & drop page builder with 50+ widgets, 3 home page variants, and 20+ payment gateways, plus advanced inventory, shipping, tax, coupon, and campaign systems. Sell on web and on native Android & iOS via the Grenmart Flutter app. One-time purchase, full source code, no monthly fees.
- [Grenmart product page](https://xgenious.com/products/grenmart-organic-grocery-ecommerce)
- [Live demo](https://grenmart.xgenious.com/)
- [Admin demo](https://grenmart.xgenious.com/login/admin)
- [Documentation](https://docs.xgenious.com/docs/grenmart-organic-grocery-laravel-ecommerce/)
- [Pricing](https://xgenious.com/products/grenmart-organic-grocery-ecommerce#pricing)
- Stack: Laravel, PHP 8+, MySQL
- Pricing: Regular $39 (web store) / Everything Bundle $49 (web + Flutter mobile app) / Exclusive $199 (white-label + full source rights + free install) — one-time, no monthly fees
- Key features: no-code drag & drop page/menu/form/widget builders (50+ widgets), 3 home variants + grid/list shop, advanced inventory, advanced shipping by zone/country/state, advance tax, coupons & time-boxed campaigns with countdown, autocomplete search, related product suggestions, wishlist/cart/compare, quick view & quick share, Facebook/Google login, default language (admin-set) + RTL support, SEO meta + one-click XML sitemap
- Mobile: Grenmart Flutter app (Android & iOS) included from the $49 Everything Bundle — single codebase connecting to the Laravel backend over API, 15+ payment gateways, Facebook login + OTP password reset
- Comparison: vs Shopify ($39–$399/mo), vs WooCommerce (free + paid plugins), vs custom build ($15K–$40K) — Grenmart is one-time, you own the Laravel source, no platform commission on sales
- Keywords: organic grocery ecommerce, grocery laravel ecommerce, laravel ecommerce script, grocery store php script, drag and drop ecommerce builder, online grocery store software
